blocks.section: High voltage diode test
blocks.content: Ensure the following requirements have been met before starting the test:

blocks.section: High voltage diode test
blocks.content:  The appliance has been disconnected from the power supply and protective measures have been taken to ensure the power cannot be switched on again.

blocks.section: High voltage diode test
blocks.content:  The appliance is cool.

blocks.section: High voltage diode test
blocks.content:  The high voltage capacitors are discharged before commencing work. See section 2.15 'How to discharge the conneX HV'

blocks.section: High voltage diode test
blocks.content:  The casing of the appliance has been removed.

blocks.content: High voltage capacitor test

blocks.section: High voltage capacitor test
blocks.content: Ensure the following requirements have been met before starting the test:

blocks.section: High voltage capacitor test
blocks.content:  The appliance has been disconnected from the power supply and protective measures have been taken to ensure the power cannot be switched on again.

blocks.section: High voltage capacitor test
blocks.content:  The appliance is cool.

blocks.section: High voltage capacitor test
blocks.content:  The high voltage capacitors are discharged before commencing work. See section 2.15 'How to discharge the conneX HV'

blocks.section: High voltage capacitor test
blocks.content:  The casing of the appliance has been removed.

blocks.section: DANGER
blocks.content: DANGER

blocks.section: DANGER
High voltages and significant currents are present at the high voltage capacitor and HV Circuit.
blocks.content: High voltages and significant currents are present at the high voltage capacitor and HV Circuit.

blocks.section: High voltages and significant currents are present at the high voltage capacitor and HV Circuit.
blocks.content: It is very dangerous to work near this part when the oven is on.

blocks.section: High voltages and significant currents are present at the high voltage capacitor and HV Circuit.
blocks.content: NEVER make any electrical measurements on the high voltage circuits, including the magnetron filament, whilst the oven is connected to the mains power supply.

blocks.section: High voltages and significant currents are present at the high voltage capacitor and HV Circuit.
blocks.content: Remove all electric connections from the high voltage capacitor.

blocks.section: High voltages and significant currents are present at the high voltage capacitor and HV Circuit.
blocks.content: Using a Digital Multi-Meter (DMM), check for continuity.

blocks.section: High voltages and significant currents are present at the high voltage capacitor and HV Circuit.
blocks.content: Results should be as follows:

blocks.section: High voltages and significant currents are present at the high voltage capacitor and HV Circuit.
High voltages and significant currents are present at the high voltage capacitor and HV Circuit.
blocks.content: Connect the DMM to both terminals of the high voltage capacitor.

blocks.section: High voltages and significant currents are present at the high voltage capacitor and HV Circuit.
blocks.content: The test is passed if the DMM display reads approx. 10 MΩ.

blocks.section: High voltages and significant currents are present at the high voltage capacitor and HV Circuit.
High voltages and significant currents are present at the high voltage capacitor and HV Circuit.
blocks.content: Connect the DMM to one terminal and the metal outer case of the high voltage capacitor.

blocks.section: High voltages and significant currents are present at the high voltage capacitor and HV Circuit.
blocks.content: The test is passed if the DMM display reads "open circuit".

blocks.section: High voltages and significant currents are present at the high voltage capacitor and HV Circuit.
blocks.content: Repeat the test for the other terminal and the metal outer case.

blocks.section: High voltages and significant currents are present at the high voltage capacitor and HV Circuit.
blocks.content: Using a megger/insulation tester, test the insulation resistance between both terminals and the metal outer case of the high voltage capacitor.

blocks.section: High voltages and significant currents are present at the high voltage capacitor and HV Circuit.
blocks.content: The test is passed if the megger/insulation tester display reads over 100 MΩ.

blocks.section: High voltages and significant currents are present at the high voltage capacitor and HV Circuit.
blocks.content: Remove both connections from the high voltage diode.

blocks.section: High voltages and significant currents are present at the high voltage capacitor and HV Circuit.
blocks.content: Using a megger/insulation tester, test for continuity in both directions.

blocks.section: High voltages and significant currents are present at the high voltage capacitor and HV Circuit.
blocks.content: Results should be as follows:

blocks.section: High voltages and significant currents are present at the high voltage capacitor and HV Circuit.
blocks.content: Open circuit both ways - FAIL

blocks.section: High voltages and significant currents are present at the high voltage capacitor and HV Circuit.
blocks.content: Conducts one-way only - PASS

blocks.section: High voltages and significant currents are present at the high voltage capacitor and HV Circuit.
blocks.content: Short circuit both ways - FAIL

blocks.section: High voltages and significant currents are present at the high voltage capacitor and HV Circuit.
blocks.content: Conducts one way, leaks the other - FAIL
